name: littlepowers
description: A proportional planning, Outcome Lock, Review Lease, opt-in delegation, recovery, debugging, verification, and review protocol for Codex, Claude Code, Qoder, and OpenCode.

interface.longDescription: Route complete approved outcomes through proportional planning, preserve them in a revisioned recovery ledger, use explicit Review Leases at planning boundaries, recommend host-native subagents only after a high-benefit gate and user authorization, prevent silent scope slicing, debug from evidence, review consequential changes, and verify completion at the actual impact scope in Codex, Claude Code, Qoder, and OpenCode.
defaultPrompt: Use Littlepowers to shape and implement the complete outcome proportionally, without product or technical slicing.
For this bounded change, brainstorm once, write the plan, then implement under my fixed mandate.
Resume or diagnose this work, then review and verify it at its actual impact and rollback scope.
